content: ARCH rules for feat-1 (per-CU ITR directories). Hexagonal architecture: domain models in itrcompiler.domain.models; compile orchestration in itrcompiler.application.services; CLI parsing in itrcompiler.control.cli; filesystem access only via itrcompiler.infrastructure.filesystem. No cross-layer dependencies. Port flow outbound to inbound. New validation failures must be typed domain errors surfaced with the offending CU id and component name.

LEGEND for feat-1. CU = Computational Unit. ITR directory = compiled output folder for one feature. CU folder = per-CU subdirectory named after the CU id (e.g. cu-001/). COORDINATES.itr = DTR area affected/created by the CU. REQUIREMENTS.itr = what part of the feature the CU adds. IMPLEMENTATION_STEPS.itr = stepwise code instructions for the Coder (gitignored). ACCEPTANCE.itr = per-CU acceptance criteria + acceptance/regression tests. SYNOPSIS.itr = ITR-root file naming implemented features and defining MAX_ATTEMPTS. MAX_ATTEMPTS = max Coder retry count per CU before escalation to code lead.

REQUIREMENTS: extend the domain model so a CU carries four named components (coordinates, requirements, implementation-steps, acceptance) plus CU-level metadata, and the batch carries synopsis data (implemented feature ids, MAX_ATTEMPTS). COORDINATES: TYPE.scala.itrcompiler.domain.models.CU.scala.CU + FILE.scala/itrcompiler/domain/models/CUBatch.scala + FILE.scala/itrcompiler/domain/models/CompileCommand.scala; a coordinates value may name a DTR area that does not exist yet, meaning the CU creates it. IMPLEMENTATION_STEPS: (1) add component fields to the CU model with a required-components set; (2) add synopsis fields (feature ids, MAX_ATTEMPTS with a sane default) to the batch model; (3) keep ARCH/LEGEND CU types and their root-level file names unchanged. ACCEPTANCE: unit tests construct CUs with all four components and a batch with synopsis data; missing-component construction is rejected at the model or validation layer (see cu-002).

REQUIREMENTS: compilation fails with a relevant error when any enforced rule is unmet: missing CU subdirectory content (any of the four components), missing root SYNOPSIS.itr, missing MAX_ATTEMPTS, or a missing/empty implementation summary in the synopsis data. Manually placed per-CU override files must be accepted without content enforcement. COORDINATES: TYPE.scala.itrcompiler.application.services.RequiredPartsValidation.scala.RequiredPartsValidation. IMPLEMENTATION_STEPS: (1) extend required-parts validation to check per-CU components and root synopsis/MAX_ATTEMPTS; (2) error messages name the CU id and the missing component/file; (3) explicitly skip content checks for Advisor-placed override files. ACCEPTANCE: T2 — batch omitting one component fails non-zero naming the component; T3 — missing MAX_ATTEMPTS fails non-zero naming it; T4 — hand-placed override file survives --force recompile byte-for-byte; T7 — missing/empty implementation summary fails non-zero naming the summary.

REQUIREMENTS: the writer emits one subdirectory per regular CU holding its four component files and NO per-CU .itr blob for component-carrying CUs (component-less legacy CUs keep one <cu-id>.itr inside their folder, never at root); keeps ARCH.itr/LEGEND.itr and other globals at the ITR root; writes root SYNOPSIS.itr (features, MAX_ATTEMPTS, implementation summary); keeps IMPLEMENTATION_STEPS.itr gitignored. COORDINATES: TYPE.scala.itrcompiler.application.services.CUStore.scala.CUStore + TYPE.scala.itrcompiler.infrastructure.filesystem.FileSystem.scala.FileSystem. IMPLEMENTATION_STEPS: (1) write cu-<id>/ subdirectories with COORDINATES.itr, REQUIREMENTS.itr, IMPLEMENTATION_STEPS.itr, ACCEPTANCE.itr; (2) keep ARCH.itr/LEGEND.itr at root; (3) write root SYNOPSIS.itr with implemented feature ids + MAX_ATTEMPTS; (4) ensure IMPLEMENTATION_STEPS.itr is gitignored (ITR-local or repo .gitignore entry); (5) preserve Advisor-placed override files on recompile. ACCEPTANCE: T1 — compiled layout matches the spec; SYNOPSIS.itr holds features, MAX_ATTEMPTS, and a non-empty implementation summary; no per-CU .itr blobs for component-carrying CUs, no .itr at root besides globals; T5 — git check-ignore passes for IMPLEMENTATION_STEPS.itr.

REQUIREMENTS: batch files (JSON/YAML) can carry the four per-CU components plus synopsis data through to the models, so the writer and validator (cu-002, cu-003) receive everything they enforce. COORDINATES: TYPE.scala.itrcompiler.control.cli.CliParser.scala.CliParser + ContentDeserialize + JSONFormat + YAMLFormat parsers. IMPLEMENTATION_STEPS: (1) extend JSON/YAML batch schema with per-CU component fields and batch-level synopsis fields (feature ids, MAX_ATTEMPTS); (2) keep backward compatibility: batches without the new fields compile as today (single content payload); (3) add CLI flags only if needed, reusing --json-content/--yaml-content/--force otherwise. ACCEPTANCE: old-schema batches still compile unchanged (regression); new-schema batches round-trip all components into the written CU folders.

REQUIREMENTS: executable proof for every feat-1 acceptance criterion (T1-T6 from the feature spec), runnable by the code lead in E2E verify. COORDINATES: none (test-only CU, runs after cu-001..cu-004). IMPLEMENTATION_STEPS: (1) add integration tests for layout output (T1), missing-component failure (T2), missing-MAX_ATTEMPTS failure (T3), override preservation (T4), gitignore check (T5); (2) add creation-semantics test (coordinates referencing a nonexistent DTR area compile cleanly) and a runner-level test that retry-then-escalate honors MAX_ATTEMPTS from SYNOPSIS.itr (T6); (3) run the full suite green. ACCEPTANCE: all new tests pass; full existing suite still passes (no regressions).
